It has a 31.58% chance to be the [[Voidling]], 21.05% chance to be the [[Void Floater]], 31.58% chance to be the [[Void Reaper]] and 15.79% chance to be the [[Elite Phantom]]. }} ==Description== The '''Elite Mystery''' is a summoner enemy that appears in both [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health and slightly fast speed. As it is an upgraded version of the [[Mystery]], it will spawn a random enemy on death. This has a 31.58% chance to be the [[Voidling]], 21.05% chance to be the [[Void Floater]], 31.58% chance to be the [[Void Reaper]] and 15.79% chance to be the [[Elite Phantom]]. ==Appearance== The '''Elite Mystery''' is an entity entirely made out of stone. It has a glowing purple question mark on its torso and multiple bandages around its head and arms. ==Strategy== *The '''Elite Mystery''' is one of the most dangerous enemies in the gamemodes it appears in. Bringing dedicated counters against it is recommended. **AOE towers like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Tesla]] are extremely useful against the '''Elite Mystery''', as it often appears in groups. However, they may not fare as well against the enemies it spawns. **As two of the enemies summoned in by the '''Elite Mystery''' have either [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] or [[Flying]], towers with hidden and flying detection are required. *As with many other [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode enemies, the '''Elite Mystery''' has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning towers that stun, such as the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] will be significantly less effective at dealing with it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Elite Mystery''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} EliteMysteryIconIG.png|'''Elite Mystery''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Elite Mystery''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Elite Mystery''' added, replacing the [[Mystery Boss]]. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **[[Voidling]] chance increased from 30% to 31.58%. **[[Void Floater]] chance decreased from 30% to 21.05%. **[[Void Reaper]] chance increased from 25% to 31.58%. **[[Elite Phantom]] chance increased from 15% to 15.79%. {{Hardcore|[[Void Floater]]|Wave 31|Elite Mystery|Wave 32|[[Void Brute]]|Wave 33}} {{Voidcore|[[Mandragora]]|Wave 31|Elite Mystery|Wave 33|[[Void Brute]]|Wave 34}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
